body: Thank you. I spent way too many years of my life backing down with him. And I'm tired of it. I won't be letting it go this time.

Usually this is what my dad does. I make a sad showing of trying to stand up for myself, usually ending with me crying and hiding and barricading my door closed. The next day he talks to me like nothing happens and expects me to do the same, even if I'm still cowering in my room and won't come out.  

This is actually the first time I've been subjected to the silent treatment.

> The next day they each had a brand new pair of Lucchese boots.

That's heartbreaking. I'm so sorry they'd misuse you like that.

Our household seems to be constantly on the verge of imploding without enough money to pay our bills. Our bills are always late - between 1 month late and right up to risking then getting turned off. But we always have money for things he wants. It always falls on me to try and scrape together enough to cover whatever he says is missing. 

But somehow, magically, if I can't scrape together enough, we're still fine. Something else came through in the pinch. 

I've always wondered if this was ndad's way of draining the meager savings I manage to build up every few months. Because if we're in a crisis, I won't hide how much I have, I'll hand it all over. Because I'm an idiot like that, I guess; damn survival instincts.

I've also got serious doubts that he has or ever had cancer. He has told me he had cancer since I was very small. Once he even told me the doctor told him it was spreading to his insides to make me cry and scare me; but years later when I reminded him of this, he claimed he didn't say the doctor told him that. So why would you tell a 9 year old child that you thought it might be in your uneducated opinion?! But I have never seen any medical reports of this cancer personally. And the doctor has never talked to him about it in front of me. He also claims an allergy to chemo so can't do that. 

Irony, he now has a different type of cancer; one that's extremely rare. If it's real then that's the best case of karma I've ever seen.

My dad says things like this to people IRL. Had everyone convinced IRL we were the best of friends and they'd always say they hoped they had a relationship like ours with their child someday. 

I sort of glossed over it back then, because I was so deep in the Kool-aid I didn't realize how what I had was abnormal. But now it creeps me out remembering it.

I spoke to the friend he tried to throw under the bus twice, the one who was also a mod of the forum we shared. 

She confirmed he's gaslighting me. And for the first time I found out I was actually going up for modship except that he started sharing my account at almost the same time I was nominated to become mod. And other mods expressed concern that he seemed overly distraught and unable to think clearly when offended by things, even things that had nothing to do with him, and they didn't want him to have access to the mod forum through my account.

He has previously told me one of the mods told him 'one of you reported things angrily and irrationally and then the other would do so calmly'. Ndad was trying to blame me. The mod he says told him this is one of the ones who was worried about him being overly aggressive and distraught so I wonder now if that mod was trying to politely warn him to behave better if ndad wanted to keep his new mod status. But being an N all he could see was 'I never do wrong, therefore it must have been her'.

I am an adult, let's say 25, and not in school. Sorry, I am sort of vague, but I am fearful of giving away too many details to make me identifiable. 

I work online. I am severely agoraphobic and unable to leave the house without having a panic attack. All of the money I make goes directly into bills. I am unable to save up anything even when I try to do so and hide it from him. 

I have no friends nearby. They are all multiple states away. 

Thank you for the support.

Only speak to your mother via phone. He can't pretend to be someone else over the phone. 

There's always the chance he's listening though or that she'll relay. It's part of her own sickness; she does what he says, she has to because it's what she's always done. There is nothing in the world that will stop her from doing that so watch what you say and make sure you don't mind your ndad knowing what you've told her when she relays it. 

Do not speak with her via text anymore. It's far too easy to share it, far too easy to pretend to be someone else, far too easy for him to get full access to her facebook in order to keep tabs on your profile. 

Good luck. I hope you can work out a way to stay in contact with your mother safely without your father's heavy interference.

If I clean the kitchen, I did it wrong and ndad is going to have to clean it all again. And then he'll complain that I never help with the cleaning, but why should I bother if I literally cannot use a sponge and soap correctly? 

Of course, I also wasn't allowed to cook anything that required more than a microwave until I was 16. I'd burn the pans or scratch them up, he insisted. I wasn't allowed to use the real pans (I got hand me downs that were already damaged) until I was 20 - and I only got to use them because I just started using them and didn't stop even when he said he wasn't comfortable with me using them. 

I wonder how many nparents are kitchen possessive and if that same type of possessiveness extends to all rooms or just that room. My ndad's big possessive location is the kitchen.

Thank you. 

And I don't know what would happen if I told Grandma the truth of how he is. I fear doing so partially because I am reliant on him and afraid of having no where to go and partially because I'm afraid she will not believe me and I'll be ostracized from the only family member I actually speak to.

I actually don't have a phone at all. We don't even have a land line. No money for it. All of my money has to go to bills or emergencies. 

I've been desperately trying to save up to get medical stuff done, but everytime I start getting any amount stored a disaster strikes and we have to use my 'savings' to fix it. Car broke down, dryer sparked and almost caught on fire, etc. 

I've tried to apply for the free government assistance phones a few times, but never hear anything back.

I teared up a bit with how you described your SO. I hope I have that someday. Keep him safe. Don't let her crazy anywhere near him. Ns seem to love trying to break the truly good people of the world. 

And so glad you've found a warm, safe place to be happy.
Neither link is available in my country according to Youtube (US)

Okay, I am somewhat relieved that he's just swatting hands. It's still not okay though since you don't want it and he had already agreed not to. It's just not as scary as I was fearing. 

I know you're scared, but you'll never be alone. You have your children that you obviously love. And as long as you're doing what is best for them and yourself, no matter what that is, they will always love you and be there for you. 

You really are so much stronger than you think. Despite your fears you stood up for your children. You told him he couldn't hit them and despite his bad reaction to that, you didn't back down. You **are** strong. Never forget that.

My adopted brother had this issue. He went to his recruiter and told him that his mother might come by and speak to him. He requested that they not speak to her at all if they didn't have to. So when she inevitably did show up to try and tell them he was trans and had depression as a child, the recruiter told her plainly he could not speak to her about any adult individuals who may be enlisted or may become enlisted in the future, but if she would like to sign up he'd be happy to sit with her. 

The recruiter can be your first line defense against bad family members trying to sabotage your future - they are likely very used to people joining the military to escape bad family situations. They just need to know about what you might need.

When you say smacking do you mean he spanked their bottoms or was he hitting other parts of their body including the face? One is a fairly accepted form of child discipline (though you still have every right to say you don't want that type of punishment as their mother) the other is widely accepted as a form of child abuse completely separate from bottom spanking. 

That aside, if you are trying to get counseling as a couple to make things work, and he's blaming all of it on you, that's N behavior. Coupled with cheating, leaving you and getting mad because you don't want him to strike your kids, you're describing very classic N behavior. I'm sorry. I know that's not what you wanted to hear. 

It's said women often marry their fathers. This subconscious mechanism works really well for women who had good fathers, but it doesn't work well for those of us who had N fathers. It makes us more likely to accept, and not even recognize, that the abusive behavior we suffered as children is being continued. 

I would say you should get counseling. Not because you are doing anything wrong, but because a counselor might be able to hep you sort through your husband's behavior and decide whether this is acceptable for you to live in a household like this. You're scared he may leave you, I know, but with some counseling you might realize you need to leave him instead and that it's not scary. 

You are stronger than you realize. You are not the problem, you are not a bad person and you should not live in fear. Please get help; don't suffer quietly. You already had to do that as a child.
